Class ComboStrafe

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.ComboStrafe
public final class ComboStrafe extends Object
Out of the line of a combo, to the side: from the second hit in a row it is taking, A or D is held for TICKS ticks after each such hit, away from the way the opponent is moving across its view (or the other way from the last time, when it is not moving across). An opponent that has it in a combo comes after it in a straight line, sprint hit after sprint hit; one that has gone to the side has to turn to follow, and its next hit comes later, from an angle, or not at all, and the fighter comes in again from there. With the jump reset (JumpReset) on the tick of the hit, it is a jump out to the side.

The user, 23 October, watching it lose rounds to combos: it "don't know how to run and run to left or right to make its combo hard to continue and go back in". From its fight traces: from the second hit of a combo on, it held W in 82 to 97 ticks in 100 (the jump reset), and the combos of three hits and more came from the whiffer, the one that jumps in for crits and the trader. See Config.comboStrafeRule.

Not thread-safe; one per fighter.
